That is, in apparent opposition to Metaphysical Foundations, moving force is taken as the basis of motion so that motion is derived from it. Opposition does not mean rejection, however, nor does it mean that Kant would at last do full justice to the Newtonian conception of force as the cause of motion. Kant’s purpose is to reveal the philosophical part in Newton’s thought that Newton could not recognize, or that he identified mistakenly as metaphysics of nature.
zh: 物理学现在被定义为“物质的动力的系统，就它能在经验中被展示而言”（XXII:511）。也就是说，与《初始根据》表面相反，动力被取为运动的基础，运动由它导出。然而对立并不意味着拒斥，也不意味着康德终于要完全公正地对待牛顿把力视为运动原因的构想。康德的目的是揭示牛顿思想中牛顿自己未能辨认、或被他错误地等同于自然形而上学的那个哲学部分。

en: In the final page of Metaphysical Foundations, which announces the Opus Postumum, Kant had already returned to the possibility that attraction might be merely apparent (cohesion). In line with the previous demonstration according to which space cannot be empty, he calls aether any matter below the threshold of perception. It would be scattered continuously over all cosmic spaces, exerting a compression such that matter is always full by virtue of its sole expansive force.
zh: 在预告《遗著》的《初始根据》最后一页，康德已经回到吸引可能只是表面现象（内聚）的可能性。依照先前关于空间不可能空虚的演证，他把处于知觉阈限之下的任何物质都称为以太。它将连续地散布于一切宇宙空间，施加一种压缩，使物质仅凭自身的膨胀力便能始终充实。

en: Kant now proposes to add physical principles to the metaphysical/mathematical principles of natural science. The principles are no longer the moving forces, because they remain dependent on the existence of a given motion. Rather, they are “forces which would never be present in matter without an external moving cause” (XXI:356). This external cause is the aether, which as matter is compressed so as to generate the phenomenon of attraction. On this basis, an attempt to deduce the two moving forces from one fundamental force (the aether) is now permitted.
zh: 康德现在提议给自然科学的形而上学/数学原理添加物理原理。这些原理不再是动力，因为动力仍依赖于给定运动的存在。毋宁说，它们是“没有外部运动原因就绝不会存在于物质中的力”（XXI:356）。这个外部原因就是以太，它作为物质被压缩，以致产生吸引的现象。在此基础上，现在允许尝试从一种基本力（以太）演绎出两种动力。

en: It is not the association of space with moving objects in it, but the deduction itself which has the effect of making space a sensible object. The concepts of physics so understood can no longer be simply given by reason or experience (given in the sense of conceptus dati). Rather, they are fabricated (conceptus factitii) (21:358) quite on purpose, as it were, in order to make possible the search for the physical principles of nature. Fabricated concepts are, Kant says, “regulative principles which are at the same time constitutive” (22:241). As a result of the fabrication, any partitioning of the appearances of the world in terms of specific categories is to be dropped; Kant speaks of a filling of space which can be either extensive or intensive. A new concept, or “third thing,” emerges from their conflation: this is the aether, which is a “continual … agitation, by attraction and repulsion” (22:211–213). As a third term, the aether as a putatively real object in the world corresponds to the transcendental schematism in the cognitive faculties. The transition (or Übergang) from mathematics and metaphysics to physics is thus something like the working out of the schematism of nature itself, disclosing what Kant called the possibility of the possibility of experience. The Critique had merely demonstrated that schematizable categories are needed to account for the possibility of experience. The question as to how they actually do that was left outside of it. By probing deeply into empirical nature, the mind probes in turn into its most original powers, and reaches a point where it has nothing to learn about new developments in science. Let us see how Kant reaches the puzzling conclusion that the aether is an object produced by the mind, which affects the mind while bypassing the mediation of empirical experience.
zh: 使空间成为感性对象的，不是空间与其中运动对象的关联，而是演绎本身。如此理解的物理学概念不能再简单地由理性或经验给予（在 conceptus dati〔所予概念〕的意义上给予）。毋宁说，它们仿佛完全是有意地被制造出来（conceptus factitii〔制成概念〕）（21:358），为的是使对自然的物理原理的探求成为可能。康德说，制成的概念是“同时是构成性的调节性原理”（22:241）。作为制造的结果，按特殊范畴对世界显象的任何划分都要放弃；康德谈到一种可以是外延的或强度的空间填充。从二者的合流中产生一个新概念或“第三者”：这就是以太，它是“凭借吸引与排斥的……持续搅动”（22:211–213）。作为第三项，作为世界中假定实在对象的以太，对应于认识能力中的先验图型法。于是从数学和形而上学到物理学的过渡（Übergang），就像是自然本身的图型法的实施，揭示出康德所谓经验之可能性的可能性。《批判》只是演证了需要可图型化的范畴来说明经验的可能性。它们实际如何做到这一点的问题被留在它之外。通过深入探查经验自然，心灵反过来探查它最源始的能力，并达到这样一个地步，于是无须再从科学的新发展中学到什么。让我们看看康德如何得出那个令人困惑的结论：以太是心灵产生的对象，它作用于心灵而无须经由经验中介。

en: Despite their non-systematic character, the moving forces given in experience can be known systematically as a whole. The concepts appropriate for this kind of knowledge will not be a part of physical science itself, since they will merely provide the formal framework for this science to be a true science. What is it that can be said about this form which is not included in Kant’s previous works? The metaphysics of nature is an intermediary step between the Critique and the Opus Postumum in the following precise sense. While in the former work Kant addressed the question of how to follow Copernicus’s “first idea” (Bxvi) in order to bring out the conditions whereby the mind has access to the outer natural world, Metaphysical Foundations presented systematically the “first principles” of the metaphysics of nature without which natural science could not be regarded as a science. Hence the various formal modes of access to the natural world are complemented with all that is real in the objects of our external senses, namely, all that is determinable in space plus the moving forces (4:523). Now, the need to give a coherent description of the moving forces which are discovered empirically captures what is at least a pretention (Tendenz at 22:166, Aufforderung at 21:635) constitutive of physical science. This pretention is even more fundamental that the principle with which science begins, since it sends us back to a form which is more primitive than any other form: by means of new a priori principles, physics is given “the sketch (Umris) of the form” (21:360) whereby the manifold of physical perceptions is organized in accordance with their predefined place in the architectonic of reason. The task of the Transition project is to provide such a formal sketch. Kant argues that this task can be accomplished if a material principle of the origin of motion can now be found within possible experience itself. This principle is the aether, which is “primary matter” (erste Materie) or “elementary matter” (Elementarstoff), or again “an element which refers to the mere existence of matter without its particular forces” (21:312, 217; 22:610). This matter is cause of its own motion, so that one must assume “uniform and constant persistence of this motion” (21:217). On account of the rational need for systematicity in the whole of experience, Kant thus ends up by postulating something like a generalized principle of inertia at the basis of the mind’s most intimate relation to the natural world. In this way a quasi-organic connection is finally brought out between the outer and the inner dimension of nature, a connection which appears as a duality in natural science via the principle of relativity and the principle of inertia.
zh: 尽管经验中给予的动力具有非系统品格，它们作为整体仍可以被系统地认识。适合于这种知识的概念将不是物理科学本身的一部分，因为它们只为这门科学成为真正的科学提供形式框架。关于这个形式，有什么是康德先前著作中没有包含而可以说的？自然形而上学是《批判》与《遗著》之间的一个中间步骤，其精确意义如下。在前一部著作中，康德处理如何遵循哥白尼的“第一观念”（Bxvi）以揭示心灵通达外部自然世界的条件的问题；《初始根据》则系统地呈现自然形而上学的“第一原理”，没有它们自然科学就不能被视为科学。于是，通达自然世界的各种形式方式，被补以我们外感官对象中一切实在的东西，即空间中一切可规定的东西加上动力（4:523）。而对经验发现的动力作出连贯描述的需要，至少体现了物理科学的一项构成性诉求（22:166 处的 Tendenz，21:635 处的 Aufforderung）。这一诉求甚至比科学由之开始的原理更根本，因为它把我们送回一个比任何其他形式都更原始的形式：借助新的先天原理，物理学被给予“形式的轮廓（Umriß）”（21:360），物理知觉的杂多借此按照它们在理性建筑术中预先确定的位置被组织起来。过渡方案的任务就是提供这样一个形式轮廓。康德论证说，如果现在能在可能经验本身之内找到一个运动起源的质料性原理，这个任务就能完成。这个原理就是以太，它是“原初物质”（erste Materie）或“基本物质”（Elementarstoff），或者又是“一个指涉物质的单纯存在而不带其特殊力的要素”（21:312, 217; 22:610）。这种物质是其自身运动的原因，因此必须假定“这种运动的匀一而恒常的持存”（21:217）。出于对全部经验之系统性的理性需要，康德最终在心灵与自然世界最内在关系的基础处设定了某种类似广义惯性原理的东西。这样，自然的外在维度与内在维度之间终于呈现出一种准有机的联系，这种联系在自然科学中经由相对性原理和惯性原理显现为一种二元性。

en: The problem with this final step is that Kant thought that the same formal structure of the mind in the Critique operates at the level of the more primitive state of the form as well. Indeed Kant goes on to argue that what makes possible the systematic unity of the moving forces is also what makes possible the material unity of experience. The aether is supposed to do this because the totality of matter is unified by means of constant activity into a whole which is both spatial and dynamic.
zh: 这最后一步的问题在于，康德认为《批判》中同一个心灵形式结构也在形式的更原始状态的层面上运作。的确，康德接着论证说：使动力的系统统一成为可能的东西，也是使经验的质料统一成为可能的东西。以太被指望做到这一点，因为物质的总体凭借恒常的活动被统一为一个既是空间性的又是动力学性的整体。

en: 10 Conclusion
zh: 10 结论

en: Kant’s merit is to be gauged against the fact that the “first idea” (Copernicus) leading to science, the “first principle” of natural science, and the “primary matter” of the mind-dependent world are all constrained by the same set of categories and ideas. Whether or not this merit is still great enough, it should be borne in mind that Kant’s interest in mathematics and physics is motivated by his concern for metaphysics, not primarily by these sciences as such. Thus in Prolegomena §40 he states that, as far as their own safety and certainty are concerned, both pure mathematics and pure natural science stood in need of transcendental investigation, “not for themselves, but for the sake of another science, namely, metaphysics.” The Metaphysical Foundations describe the lesson that transcendental philosophy is to retain from their unique combination successfully achieved by Newton in mathematical physics: i.e., an access to the a priori conditions of possibility of natural knowledge via their outer representation. Hence the principles of pure understanding are not to be seen as specialized in accordance with intuition and empirical experience. Rather, through contact with the propositions of natural science, they open themselves up to an outer representation of what they are as pure ideas.
zh: 康德的功绩应当对照如下事实来衡量：导向科学的“第一观念”（哥白尼）、自然科学的“第一原理”、以及依赖心灵的世界的“原初物质”，全都受同一组范畴和理念约束。无论这一功绩是否仍然足够伟大，都应记住：康德对数学和物理学的兴趣是由他对形而上学的关切激发的，而不是首先由这些科学本身激发的。于是他在《导论》第40节中陈述：就其自身的安全与确定性而言，纯粹数学和纯粹自然科学都需要先验研究，“不是为了它们自己，而是为了另一门科学，即形而上学”。《初始根据》描述了先验哲学应当从牛顿在数学物理学中成功实现的二者的独特结合中吸取的教训：即通过自然知识的先天可能性条件的外在表象来认识这些条件。因此，纯粹知性原理不应被看作依照直观和经验而被特殊化的。毋宁说，通过与自然科学命题的接触，它们向自身作为纯粹理念之所是的一种外部表象敞开自己。
